name: songfest
description: Collaborative music management for private parties

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @songfest/shared && npm run build --workspace @songfest/api && npm run build --workspace @songfest/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @songfest/shared && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @songfest/api" "npm run dev --workspace @songfest/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @songfest/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @songfest/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @songfest/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
